comment: Part-Swap Configurator, Part A deliverable. Workspace: DCicero/configurators. Mount convention: origin = center of the flange bolt face; +Z = away from the flange (direction the tool extends); +Y = up. Tools are authored with ALL node transforms identity; the mount frame lives in vertex data.

base.note: v3 (2026-08-26): torch-adapter hardware removed; tools now mount directly on the arm's own bolt-circle tool flange. Mount point moved accordingly (read it dynamically from ToolMount / ToolMountMarker, never hardcode). Repo-served file contains the ToolMount empty (identity rotation at the flange). The PLATFORM-served conversion DROPS empties: derive the mount point from the world-space bounding-box center of the ToolMountMarker mesh instead (a 0.6mm triangle whose bbox center IS the mount point; it inherits the same uniform recenter shift as the arm, so a world-space Box3 lookup is always correct).

platformGotcha: The platform pipeline (Convert Only) injects ONE recenter translation on each mesh node and drops mesh-less (empty) nodes. Vertex data is preserved byte-identical. Therefore: (1) for platform-served TOOL scenes, zero every node's position/rotation/scale to identity before parenting (tools are authored all-identity, so any nonzero TRS is optimizer-injected); (2) for the platform-served BASE, do NOT strip (the shift is uniform and harmless) and locate the mount via the ToolMountMarker world bbox center.

legacyCombinedProducts.note: The five monolithic arm+tool products being replaced; keep until the split page ships, then retire.
